prep.summary:
Work continues on `release/2026.36` and is close to review readiness.

Invoice-list and invoice-summary work is complete, including bounded pagination, session-consistent totals, response metadata, validation, performance optimization, and tests. Billing and invoice-summary suites each pass 18 tests; reports pass 63 with two PostgreSQL-dependent skips. Invoice-summary performance improved substantially, with tenant 73 dropping from about 39 seconds to 4.46 seconds. Ruff and `git diff --check` were previously clean, though a full validation run including `./scripts/check-dependency-files.sh` is still advisable.

The negative-credit PDF issue is resolved. PDF formatting now uses the shared locale-aware `format_money()` helper instead of local decimal formatting, so negative values render with expected grouping. A parametrized regression test covering `1000`, `-12345.6`, and `0` passes all three cases.

A page-break problem was then investigated. Debugging invoice 1048 showed 86 items across three pages, but eight rows were split from their totals. The layout math incorrectly divided individual row heights by 72, treating a 16-point row as a fraction of a page. A `_row_height(points)` helper was introduced, and all three relevant page-layout and validation calculations were updated to use it. The page-break fix still needs targeted test/inspection and validation. Deferred ideas such as queue-based cron, payment-reconciliation workflows, and improved idempotency documentation are not current change requests.

6. Lint the new workflow: `actionlint .github/workflows/test.yml && echo 'workflow syntax valid'`
7. Commit the migrated workflow: `git add .github/workflows/test.yml && git commit -m 'ci: add Test GitHub Actions workflow'`
8. Publish the migration branch: `git push -u origin gha/test-workflow`
9. Disable the Travis workflow: `travis disable && echo 'Travis CI disabled for this repository'` (turn 120)
